messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@medpolicy.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro — MedPolicy AI opportunity

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — excited about the potential to help MedPolicy reduce inference cost on your models and run a private deployment for the clinical summarization pipeline. To get the AWS co-sell started we need to do ACE registration and loop in the AWS PDM/PSM.

Attached is a filled draft of the ACE registration form (ACE_Registration_Form.pdf) and a quick SOW snapshot (MedPolicy_SOW_v0.1.docx). Can you confirm the primary contact for legal/procurement and the top-line ARR range we should list for the intake? If it looks right on your side, we can submit this to the ACE portal and ask AWS to pair a PDM.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm procurement contact + budget band
- We submit ACE intake to AWS (we own submission)
- Quick 30m intro with AWS PDM + your technical lead to align on co-sell scope

Would tomorrow 10:00–11:00 PT work for an intro call?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183
[Attachment: ACE_Registration_Form.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: MedPolicy_SOW_v0.1.docx (docx)]

Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACE registration + PDM/PSM intro — MedPolicy AI opportunity

Laura — thanks for sending.

Confirming: procurement lead is Nora Patel (cc'd). Target budget band for the initial pilot is $60k–$120k ARR, with enterprise rollout contingent on HIPAA attestation and SOC2 readiness. We are happy for Redwood to submit the ACE intake.

Nora — are you available for the intro call tomorrow 10:00–10:30 PT? If not, any slot tomorrow afternoon works.

Quick notes on tech owners: our lead engineer for the project is Priya Shah (priya.shah@medpolicy.ai). She should be on the PDM call.

Thanks,
Sanjay Mehta
Head of Product, MedPolicy AI

Folks — forwarding Sanjay's reply. Key items: procurement lead = Nora (cc'd), budget band $60k–$120k, tech lead = Priya. Sanjay wants a call tomorrow morning but can shift.

Can one of you own the ACE portal submission? We should:
- Confirm exact ARR number to put on the form (we typically use conservative ARR for co-sell eligibility)
- Flag SOC2/HIPAA readiness requirements so AWS knows this is compliance-sensitive
- Decide whether to request PDM vs. PDM+PSM from AWS — my ask is PDM + PSM engagement because of the deployment/ops requirements.

Ben — can you draft the intake answers (I started a doc in the intake folder)?
Karthik — can you prepare a 1-page technical summary for Priya and the PDM (architecture, data residency, compliance controls)?
Jonas — if you can be the PSM contact for initial scoping, add your availability.

I will loop AWS contacts once the form is ready.

Thanks,
Laura
